Risk: Hallucinated / Synthetic Dead URLs (Fictitious file paths generated without live verification, e.g., /cable-manufacturing-should-cost-model-architecture-deepdive.pptx)
Impact: $500,000 - $1,500,000 procurement loss; 8-12 weeks renegotiation slip. Model cannot be defended during vendor negotiation; contract collapses (Severity S = 8)
Risk Triggers: User browser renders 404; network logs record HTTP 404; dead reference link reported; URL syntax looks valid but endpoint does not resolve

Risk: Soft-404 & Content Removal Masking (Host returns HTTP 200 OK while body contains 'Presentation removed', 'Slide not found', or generic portal landing)
Impact: $100,000 - $450,000 production downtime; 24-72 hours emergency remediation. Team relies on deleted asset during live outage migration (Severity S = 7)
Risk Triggers: Browser displays 'Presentation removed'; page title is generic login/404; response HTML Content-Length < 1.5 KB with HTTP 200 OK

Risk: Bot-Shield False Negative (Cloudflare 403 on Elsevier/ScienceDirect - automated probe blocked by publisher bot-shield and misclassified as dead)
Impact: $250,000 - $1,000,000 architectural rework; 3-5 months delayed feature rollout. Peer-reviewed benchmarks disqualified; team adopts unverified blog post (Severity S = 8)
Risk Triggers: HTTP 403 Forbidden received; response contains CF-RAY header or 'server: cloudflare'; link resolves successfully in human browser

Risk: Domain Expiry & Malicious Redirect (Author domain expires; domain squatter redirects traffic to spam, phishing, or malware payload)
Impact: $1,000,000 - $5,000,000 security breach remediation, forensic investigation, and audit penalties; 6+ months remediation (Severity S = 9)
Risk Triggers: Destination URL hostname changes abruptly (e.g., tech-example.org redirects to spam-casino.xyz); SSL certificate domain mismatch; unexpected geo-redirect

Risk: Unconsented Simulated Data Drift (Critic evaluates candidates on synthetic/simulated data without explicit user agreement)
Impact: $200,000 - $600,000 architectural rework; 4-8 weeks unplanned redesign. Production system fails under load because synthetic inputs did not mirror production reality (Severity S = 6)
Risk Triggers: Telemetry discrepancies between lab benchmarks and field telemetry; synthetic distribution markers; unflagged synthetic provenance
